title: Briefing Rogue Squadron
description: Rogue Squadron, a team of seasoned Rebel star pilots, many of whom had been instrumental in the historic destruction on the Death Star, were generally called into action whenever the Empire launched an attack. On the ice world of Hoth, a refuge and strategy center known as Echo Base faced Imperial retaliation in the form of massive AT-ATs, dispatched by Darth Vader to destroy the Rebels' power generators. As always, Princess Leia offered all assembled fighters confidence and hope in her bnefing.
